description: This file defines the ContextJava class, which encapsulates variables related to generating Java files, including filename, class name, and package name. It provides getter and setter methods for these variables and a method to check if the Java file was generated.

classes.name: ContextJava
classes.description: A class that holds context-specific variables for generating Java source files, such as filename, class name, and package name.

methods.name: wasGenerated
methods.description: Checks whether the Java file name has been set, indicating if the Java source has been generated.
